topic_title: Legal Definition of Intoxication in Texas
prompt: Which bodily specimens are authorized under Texas law to establish statutory alcohol concentration?

options.text: Hair follicle samples, perspiration swabs, or saliva swab test strips
Dermal skin patch sensors and retinal pupil light dilation measurements
Thermal body imaging scans and speech vocal frequency wave analysis
Grams of alcohol per 100 mL of blood, 210 L of breath, or 67 mL of urine
